extracted.name: Vegetable cheese dip
extracted.description: This versatile cheese dip is packed with hidden veg. Perfect for little hands to dip into or alternatively spread in sandwiches or pittas for a lunch box – kids will love it!
ingredient_lines: 1 small red pepper very finely chopped
pitta bread or mini breadsticks, carrot sticks and baby cucumbers, to serve
instruction_lines: Tip the cream cheese, cheddar, pepper and celery into a mixing bowl and stir together until well combined. Spoon the dip in to a bowl and serve with raw vegetables and strips of wholemeal pitta bread or breadsticks to scoop it up with.
